triage_candidates.statement: Handoff close-criteria contradiction at cores=1: balanced maps to (max(1,cores//2)=1 workers, 2 threads), but the stated absolute invariant n_workers*threads<=cores requires product<=1. The two decided criteria conflict only at cores=1 (balanced). Recommended resolution: treat the invariant as the hard guarantee and additionally clamp threads_per_worker so the product never exceeds cores (threads 2->1 at cores=1 balanced); the per-level mapping then describes the cores>=2 case. Needs Commander confirmation since both are 'decided do not re-litigate'.
